eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Santa Fe, NM; at 5:29 PM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 1:29 AM AUG 11, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Due to increased activity on the Frijoles Fire, the communities of Cundiyo and Cerro Pinon are placed in Set status. The road of Camino de Canon remains under evacuation (GO Status).  There is no evacuation order for any other area at this time.
Residents should be prepared in case conditions change. Gather essential items and make a plan to leave if evacuation orders are issued. Stay vigilant of changing conditions.
